meta.executedQueryString:
WITH asking AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 day', snapshot_time) AS time, gpu_type,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_price_per_gpu) AS med,
         count(DISTINCT executor_id) AS nodes
  FROM executor_price_history
  WHERE snapshot_time BETWEEN '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-11-16T00:00:00Z'
    AND extract(epoch FROM snapshot_time)::bigint % 21600 = 0
    AND NOT rented
    AND asking_price_per_gpu IS NOT NULL
    AND gpu_type IS NOT NULL
    AND ('All' = 'All' OR gpu_type = 'All') AND ('All' = 'All' OR tier = 'All')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
paid AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 day', snapshot_time) AS time, gpu_type,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_per_gpu) AS med,
         count(DISTINCT executor_id) AS nodes
  FROM rental_snapshots
  WHERE snapshot_time BETWEEN '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-11-16T00:00:00Z'
    AND extract(epoch FROM snapshot_time)::bigint % 21600 = 0
    AND price_per_gpu IS NOT NULL
    AND gpu_type IS NOT NULL
    AND ('All' = 'All' OR gpu_type = 'All') AND ('All' = 'All' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM executor_price_history h WHERE h.executor_id = rental_snapshots.executor_id AND h.snapshot_time > rental_snapshots.snapshot_time - interval '15 minutes' AND h.snapshot_time <= rental_snapshots.snapshot_time AND h.tier = 'All'))
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT time, gpu_type || ' - asking, unrented' AS metric, med::float8 AS value FROM asking WHERE nodes >= 3
UNION ALL
SELECT time, gpu_type || ' - paid, rented' AS metric, med::float8 AS value FROM paid WHERE nodes >= 3
ORDER BY 1, 2
